label: Deliver at
hint: In the install's time zone (TZ in the deploy's env file).

label: Send as
choices: One book a day, with a contents page

label: Ignore articles older than (days)
hint: Counted from when an article was first seen. Also how far back Hacker News is searched, and how long a pick shown only as a link is tried again.

label: Most articles in one story
Longest article (words)
hint: A failsafe against manuals and whole books; 0 for no limit.

label: Grayscale images
hint: Turn off for a colour e-reader.

label: Let Claude choose the articles
hint: Needs FORENOON_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the deploy's env file. Off, or without a key: pinned sources first, then newest first.

label: Model
Tokens a day, at most
hint: Input (cached input too) and output together, all readers. A call that would cross it is skipped.

label: Articles read in full before choosing
hint: The best-ranked candidates are fetched and read by the model; 0 judges on titles and openings only.

label: Places for a random lower-ranked article
hint: 1 gives the day's last place to something the model ranked lower; 0 never does.

label: Let Claude choose the day's set from what it read
hint: One more call: the articles read in full are weighed together, for a varied issue rather than just the highest scores. Off: the highest scores, in order.

label: Model for choosing the day's set
hint: One small call a day; a stronger model here costs a few cents. Sonnet costs about 20 times Haiku.

label: Most articles on one broad subject
hint: When Claude chooses the day's set: security, AI, chips and so on; a story counts once. 0 for no limit.

label: Group articles on the same event into one story
Deliver the page a short post is about
Print the model's reason in the book
Keep notes on what each reader's ratings show
hint: About once a week the model rewrites a short note per reader, which is given to it beside their interests. Readers see and edit theirs on the account page.

label: Model for the extraction check
Ask the model whether each article looks complete
hint: Logged in the report; never changes what is delivered.

label: Email when a run needs attention
hint: A failed delivery, a crashed run, or a source that keeps failing.

label: Send alerts to
Failed runs in a row before a source is reported
Also when there was nothing new to deliver
Keep each article's saved page (days)
hint: -1 keeps them for good, 0 keeps none. They are the only copy of what was read.
